assert: no leftover debug print statements (console.log / print( / dbg!) in tracked source
cmd: git rev-parse --is-inside-work-tree >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 1; if (set +e; git grep -nE 'console\.log\(|print\(|dbg!\(' -- ':(exclude)*test*' ':(exclude)*spec*' ':(exclude)*.md' >/dev/null 2>&1); then false; else test "$?" -eq 1; fi
